description: Small public-information discovery benchmark for PlanCheck's likely NZ, AU, technical-document, and overseas-price searches.

cases.label: Exact New Zealand product price
cases.intent: Find a current public NZ supplier price for an exact construction product.
cases.query: GIB Aqualine 10mm 1200 x 2400 price New Zealand

cases.label: New Zealand category and supplier discovery
cases.intent: Find locally available products and suppliers when the product is not fully specified.
cases.query: below ground waterproofing membrane suppliers price New Zealand

cases.label: Exact Australian product price
cases.intent: Find a current public Australian supplier price for an exact construction product.
cases.query: James Hardie Villaboard 6mm 1200 x 2400 price Australia

cases.label: Manufacturer technical and installation document
cases.intent: Find an authoritative product data sheet or installation guide, including PDFs.
cases.query: SikaProof A+ 12 installation guide product data sheet

cases.label: United States comparison price
cases.intent: Find a public US price for an exact construction product or SKU.
cases.query: Simpson Strong-Tie HDU5-SDS2.5 price United States

cases.label: Ambiguous New Zealand product description
cases.intent: Test useful local discovery when the description is generic rather than a model number.
cases.query: 250 micron DPM polythene price New Zealand construction
